summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements and proposals, including the addition of a variant type to the REST catalog spec and the potential deprecation of equality deletes in Iceberg V4. Community members are also engaged in ongoing syncs to address integration with Spark and to explore file-level access delegation in the REST Catalog specification.
highlights: Hilbert curve clustering proposal for better data skipping
Discussion on variant type in REST catalog spec
Proposal to deprecate equality deletes in Iceberg V4
Incremental scan semantics inclusion in the table specification
